purpose: Stress-test the unchanged two-visit workflow and produce conservative descriptive diagnostics that may widen but never narrow the prior pessimistic completion, burden, gaze-eligibility, class-prevalence, or crossed-cluster planning ranges.
timeline_and_blinding: Freeze this contract and the practical-effect worksheet before opening any target rehearsal or future confirmation cohort word-review outcome or model-comparison result.
Run the existing standardized rehearsal flow without adaptive routing, threshold changes, or participant-specific model tuning.
Create a blinded aggregate containing process, quality, class-count, and cluster-structure diagnostics but no F0, F1, or F2 predictions, losses, or comparison results.
Apply the frozen stop/go rules without adding participants beyond eight to chase a pass.

Use blinded diagnostics only to retain or widen prior pessimistic planning ranges; never narrow a completion, gaze, prevalence, or ICC range from five to eight people, and collect a separate frozen confirmation cohort for any model claim.

allowed: calibration, drift, sampling, missingness, and gaze-eligibility descriptions
three-class word-review counts and prevalence ranges for planning
participant and passage-family cluster-input completeness and conservative prior-widening diagnostics
software, resume, export, withdrawal, and exact-fallback process checks
prohibited: cognitive ability, attention, fatigue, reading ability, English proficiency, or CEFR
formal sample-size authorization from rehearsal point estimates
threshold tuning or model evaluation on the same participants, passages, probes, captures, or devices

completion_definitions.visit1_consented_attempt: a versioned consent submission is accepted for a valid pseudonymous invitation even if subsequent session creation, camera preflight, or reading startup fails
completion_definitions.visit1_started: a pseudonymous invitation pair has an accepted consent record and a created Visit 1 session before any required reading passage
completion_definitions.visit1_completed: exactly one authoritative general_collection_completed event exists after every required Visit 1 passage, word-review audit, end validation, and debrief state is persisted
completion_definitions.visit2_started: the paired Visit 2 code is consumed 18 to 72 hours after the Visit 1 completion event under the frozen device policy
completion_definitions.visit2_completed: exactly one authoritative general_collection_completed event exists after every required Visit 2 passage, word-review audit, end validation, and debrief state is persisted
completion_definitions.paired_completed: Visit 1 and Visit 2 both meet their completion definitions for the same invitation pair with no withdrawal or unreconciled protocol deviation
required_report: exact withdrawal and protocol-deviation counts without free-text identifiers
missing denominator reported as not_estimable rather than zero

burden_definitions.active_visit_seconds: sum of recorded active phase durations from accepted consent through debrief; exclude the between-visit interval, background-tab time, and researcher pauses
burden_definitions.wall_clock_attempt_seconds: elapsed time from accepted consent to completion, withdrawal, explicit abort, or last durable event; include background-tab time and researcher pauses but exclude the between-visit interval
burden_definitions.censored_unfinished_attempt_seconds: observed wall-clock seconds from accepted consent to the last durable event for every unfinished attempt; never discard or recode as a completed duration
burden_definitions.calibration_validation_seconds: active seconds in start calibration, start validation, end validation, and any quality retry
burden_definitions.reading_review_seconds: active seconds in required passages and their post-reading word-review audits
burden_definitions.researcher_intervention_count: count of moderator actions needed to continue beyond the frozen instructions; ordinary scripted prompts are excluded
burden_definitions.forced_restart_count: count of sessions restarted because resume could not restore the frozen state
required_summaries: median, minimum, maximum, and individual pseudonymous active_visit_seconds for completed and unfinished attempts separately
median, minimum, maximum, and individual pseudonymous wall_clock_attempt_seconds with completion or censoring status
all censored_unfinished_attempt_seconds and terminal reason codes
researcher_intervention_count by visit and reason code

gaze_eligibility_definition.numerator: scheduled capture opportunities classified word_level_candidate by the already-frozen independent start/end validation and sampling rules
gaze_eligibility_definition.denominator: all scheduled capture opportunities after accepted consent including never-started, failed, incomplete, behavioral_only, and passage_level_only captures; no-capture is ineligible
required_report: numerator, denominator, fraction, and participant-cluster bootstrap 95 percent interval
never-started, failed, incomplete, and completed capture counts

class_prevalence_input.passage_probe_id_definition: canonical_passage_id_double_colon_probe_id; bare probe_id is prohibited as a global key
class_prevalence_input.planning_summary: report raw counts plus Hajek-normalized inverse-sampling-weighted proportions with participant-by-passage-family crossed-cluster intervals; do not collapse unsure after seeing counts
class_prevalence_input.five_to_eight_person_use: descriptive_only; retain or widen the prior pessimistic prevalence range and never narrow it

outcome_inputs: three one-vs-rest indicators in frozen class order
icc_planning_inputs.frozen_estimator: none_authorized_at_five_to_eight_participant_clusters; retain the full prior pessimistic participant and passage-family ICC ranges and only report cluster counts and boundary diagnostics
required_report: unique participant and passage-family cluster counts
cross-tabulated observation counts per participant and passage family for every frozen indicator
zero-variance, complete-separation, and sparse-cell boundary diagnostics
the unchanged prior pessimistic participant and passage-family ICC ranges or wider ranges if diagnostics require them

STOP_AND_INVESTIGATE: any consent, withdrawal, invitation-pair, cross-visit identity, or protected-data integrity failure
any prohibited claim, model-score access, outcome-dependent threshold change, or participant-specific tuning
any behavioral word-review row removed solely because gaze was unavailable or ineligible
REPAIR_AND_REPEAT_REHEARSAL: fewer than 5 consented Visit 1 attempts by the frozen cap of 8
fewer than 5 paired completions or paired completion fraction below 0.75 using consented Visit 1 attempts as denominator
any unresumable attempt or more than 20 percent of consented visit attempts require a forced restart
median active completed-visit duration above 45 minutes, fewer than 80 percent of completed visits finish within 60 active minutes, or any unfinished attempt lacks censored wall-clock burden
quality disposition missing for any scheduled capture opportunity or more than 5 percent of required gaze-quality fields missing after counting structurally unavailable fields explicitly
word-level gaze eligibility below 0.30 across all scheduled opportunities or fewer than 3 unique participants contribute an eligible opportunity
valid word-review labels below 0.98 of scheduled probes
HOLD_NUISANCE_UPDATE: five to eight people may never narrow completion, gaze-eligibility, class-prevalence, participant-ICC, or passage-family-ICC prior pessimistic ranges
any review class with fewer than 10 labels or fewer than 3 contributing participants widens the rare-class planning range
fewer than 5 unique participants or 8 unique passage families widens the cluster planning ranges
the practical-effect worksheet lacks externally verified pre-outcome evidence and independent manual signoff
GO_TO_BLINDED_FEASIBILITY_PLANNING_ONLY: all STOP_AND_INVESTIGATE and REPAIR_AND_REPEAT_REHEARSAL conditions are false
completion, burden, gaze eligibility, class prevalence, and ICC inputs are reported with frozen denominators and missingness
the practical-effect worksheet is machine-verified against external pre-outcome evidence and independently signed off
go_does_not_authorize: effect, accuracy, ability, proficiency, attention, fatigue, or learning-benefit claims
